text_block_list.text:
Lately, rumors of Бива Хаяхидэ going
on an
indefinite hiatus have spread
across the racing
world. Hearing such
talk sends Нарита Брайан into a
rage.

She reflects on her sister's condition up
until this
point. The thought that
Hayahide may never
return shakes Narita
Brian to her core.

However, when I ask her whether truly
believes
that's true, she's reminded of
her sister's strength
and—through
tears—chooses to believe in her.

While this is happening, Бива Хаяхидэ
is
earnestly devoting herself to her
rehabilitation to
return to the track, with
no thought of giving up
in her head.
